title: Compute Confusion Matrix with Normalization
description:
Build a $K\times K$ confusion matrix whose row is the true class and whose column is the predicted class:

$$
C_{ij}=\sum_{n=1}^{N}\mathbf{1}[y_n=i\ \text{and}\ \hat{y}_n=j]
$$

Here, $N$ is the sample count, $K$ is the number of classes, $y_n$ is the true label, and $\hat{y}_n$ is the predicted label. The normalize mode is "none" for counts, "true" for rows summing to one, "pred" for columns summing to one, or "all" for the entire matrix summing to one. A zero row or column remains zero. Return the matrix as a NumPy array.
